protocol.role: development mechanism diagnosis; no independent confirmation

interventions.k26_on_strict_loss: use K26 when its support is below exact; use exact otherwise
interventions.k26_on_equal_score: use K26 on equal-support decisions; use exact otherwise
interventions.first_difference_once: replace only the first mean-flow-relevant action difference on the shared exact prefix, then return to exact

protocol.primary_accounting: arrival barrier wait + deferred visible queue wait + dispatch-to-completion time, over all jobs including drain
protocol.diagnostic_cost: both decisions computed offline and cached by queue; intervention modes are not budget-26 schedulers

limitations: Development seeds and a deterministic cached phase model support mechanism diagnosis, not an additional confirmation or physical-hardware claim.
Exact means maximum per-frame support, not optimal long-run mean flow.
Accounting components are exact identities, not separately identified causal effects.
Switch interventions identify the total effect of their complete action-selection rule; they do not isolate duration, loaded placement, or service count individually.
Strict-loss-only and equal-score-only interventions visit different endogenous queues; their effects cannot be added to decompose the full K26 policy effect.
The first-difference intervention changes one full action and follows exact afterwards; its effect cannot be summed to explain the full K26 trajectory.
Per-run search counters replay the frozen decision accounting; offline_shadow_work counts the actual cached selected-plus-shadow queries. These counters are not additive runtime costs.
